chapter: Kansas City bands and the Blue Devils
title: Joining the Blue Devils through Buster Smith and Booker Pittman
summary: He knew Buster Smith and Booker Pittman from the Blue Moon Chasers and moved on to the Blue Devils when he got hungry.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, how did you come to get with the Blue Devils?
Probably through Buster Smith and Booker Pittman. I knew them when they had the band they called the Blue Moon Chasers.

Which was a good band, because they had Booker Pittman, (inaudible) and Buddy Johnson was in that band, Herschel, and when ______ went out, I think Buster Smith came in. And you hear them, you get with that band a little while and then -- let's go to the Blue Devils. You get hungry and you go to the Blue Devils.
